name: sendSecureMessage
shortDescription: Facilitates secure, encrypted, and auditable communication between patients and their assigned doctors, with webhook notifications.
description:
Overview

Handles the sending of secure, encrypted messages between patients and doctors. It ensures messages are properly linked to relevant patient and doctor entities, are auditable, and triggers webhook notifications upon creation.

Intended use

Called by the secure messaging interface within the patient portal or doctor dashboard when a user sends a new message.

Logic

  1. Validate input parameters, including senderId, receiverId, and content.
  2. Retrieve sender (PatientProfile or DoctorProfile) and receiver (PatientProfile or DoctorProfile) to ensure valid participants.
  3. Create a new Message record with the provided content, linking it to the sender, receiver, and optionally an appointmentId. The content attribute is encrypted by the platform.
  4. Send a webhook notification to external endpoints about the new message using ctx.webhook.send.
  5. Audit-log the message creation using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return the created Message record.

Entities

  • Message
  • PatientProfile
  • DoctorProfile

External Services

  • OutboundWebhook
